select i.id,item_name,i.item_code,i.order_process_config_id,i.item_type,i.item_value,p.biz_org_code,i.creator,i.create_time,i.is_delete from opt_dir_order_process_config_item i inner join opt_dir_order_process_config c on c.id = i.order_process_config_id inner join opt_dir_order_process p on p.id = c.order_process_id where p.order_type_config_id = #{orderTypeConfigId} and p.process_code = #{processCode} and c.process_config_code = #{processCodeConfigCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p.is_delete = 0 and c.is_delete = 0 and i.is_delete = 0
